en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of an outdoor restaurant terrace beside a wooden house. Numerous empty metal tables and chairs are arranged under large leafy trees along a gravel path. In the foreground there are benches and garden furniture, and in the background a fence and more trees frame a bright open area, possibly near water. Printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.
